Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54924
Court No. - 14

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 13610 of 2022
Applicant :- Gopal Alias Ram Gopal
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Pratap Singh,Hari Bux Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Shiv Prakash Singh
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by the State is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Hari Bux Singh, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A.
for the State and perused the record.
3.

This second bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Gopal Alias Ram Gopal for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.376 of 2019, under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station Mailani,
District Kheri, during trial as his first bail application has been dismissed as not pressed vide order dated 01.02.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.7449 of 2020.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case only on account of local enmity and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

1 5.
It is further submitted that incident in the F.I.R. is shown to have occurred in the night of 30.10.2019 at about 10:00pm.

and the allegations have been levelled that when the prosecutrix/victim had opened the door of her house, the accused/applicant, who was sitting outside her house, had grabbed her and thereafter she was taken to an agricultural field of sugarcane and was raped.

6. It is also submitted that though the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. had alleged the factum of rape against the instant applicant but keeping in view the fact that no injury of any kind or even a scratch has not been found on her body and no opinion has been given with regard to the commission of rape while the prosecutrix was medically examined on 01.11.2019 casts a cloud of suspicion over the whole story as the oral allegations of the incident are not corroborated by the medical evidence.
7. It is further submitted that there is no pathological report, which may corroborate the ocular version of the incident.
The age of the prosecutrix is aged about 19 years at the time and date of the incident.

The applicant is detained in prison since 2019 and not a single witness has been presented before the trial court by the prosecution and having regard to the pace with which the trial is going on, the same is not expected to conclude in near future.

8. It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 19.11.2019 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.

9. Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that having regard to the fact that the factum of rape has been corroborated by the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., therefore, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

10. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the prosecutrix at the relevant point of time was aged about 19 years and the F.I.R. of the incident has been lodged by the prosecutrix herself, wherein she had stated that on the relevant day at about 10:00pm.

she had gone outside her house to ease out, however, she was grabbed by the applicant and he also closed her mouth and had taken her to agricultural field and also committed rape and thereafter he left her near her home.
The prosecutrix appears to have maintained the same story in her statement recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C.
In the medical examination of the prosecutrix, which was conducted in the next morning i.e. 01.11.2019, no abnormality or any injury etc. has been detected.

It is in this background, it is submitted that the prosecutrix appears to be a consenting party, which may also be noticed in the statement of the prosecutrix given to the Doctor at the time of her medical examination.

Keeping in view the period of detention coupled with that fact that till now not a single witness has been testified before the trial court, the same amounts to the substantial change in circumstances since rejection of his first bail though as not pressed.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 19.11.2019 Gopal Alias Ram Gopal vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

11. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

12. Let the accused/applicant- Gopal Alias Ram Gopal involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
14. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
15. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.

Order Date :- 18.8.2023 Anupam S/-
